Definability-as-fiber-constancy: a readout is Sigma_f-definable iff it is constant on f-fibers and factors through q_f (the general backbone that F27 specializes by taking f = orbit map).

main_steps: 1. Declare the symmetry/route: supply the group/route action on X and form the orbit-quotient map q_orb (external input; this is where the physics enters).
2. Define 'conserved' as orbit-constancy of the candidate readout C (the SBT reading of a conservation law).

3. Apply the orbit-descent biconditional (thm:F27): conserved iff C factors through q_orb iff C is a Sigma_orb-definable / closure-invariant readout. This is the already-Lean-certified core and is essentially a one-paragraph universal-algebra argument.

4. Add the dynamics reading: state HL-META-1 explicitly as a hypothesis (the declared dynamics respects ~_orb) so that the conserved label is a well-defined sector under the SBT update; cite F18 Lawhood Descent that lawhood requires the descended readout be declared at the access layer.

5. Read off the layer instantiations already in F27 (Lavoisier mass, Reidemeister/Jones-Alexander, subject reduction, Meselson-Stahl, martingale) as one normal form, and place Noether/momentum as the classical-variational instance WITHOUT claiming to derive the current.
6. Fence the scope explicitly: state that step 3 captures only conserved<=>orbit-invariant, NOT the existence-of-current direction; the symmetry group and the symmetry->current map are imported.
data_comparison_steps: No empirical dataset is involved or appropriate: F27 is a structural normal form, not a numerical/empirical claim (SBT disclaims empirical realization).

Cross-domain consistency check (already in paper, can be re-exhibited as worked examples): instantiate the orbit quotient in each of the five declared layers and confirm the standard invariant (total mass; Jones/Alexander polynomial; typing judgement under reduction; template-strand identity; conditional expectation) is orbit-constant and recovers the textbook conservation statement.

Sanity 'null' check: exhibit a readout NOT constant on the declared orbits (e.g. a gauge-variant coordinate) and confirm it fails to descend, so F27 correctly classifies it as non-conserved relative to that declared symmetry.
proof_route.minimum_viable_result: Restate and re-exhibit F27 as a SINGLE Lean-certified quotient-definability normal form: 'conserved = orbit-quotient-definable = closure-invariant', specializing the Foundations I definability backbone to the orbit map, and tabulate Lavoisier/mass, Reidemeister/knot-invariant, subject-reduction, Meselson-Stahl, and martingale as five instances of the one statement, with Noether named (not derived) as the variational instance. This already exists and is Lean-anchored; the deliverable is the honest unifying write-up plus the explicit scope fence.
proof_route.stronger_result: A genuine SELECTION result: tie the choice of WHICH symmetry/orbit is physically realized to an SBT stability/closure criterion (e.g. show that the orbit quotient that survives idempotent packaging E, or the one minimizing closure deficit CD_tau, coincides with the realized conserved sector), so that conservation laws are not merely re-described but their realized content is constrained by SBT machinery. This would convert R018 from a re-description into a partial derivation of which conserved quantities appear.
estimated_bottlenecks: The hard bridge lemma (continuous symmetry => existence of conserved current) is genuinely out of scope: there is no continuum, no Lagrangian, no variational calculus, and no stochastic-lens backbone in the certified core, so the deep content of Noether cannot be produced from within SBT.

The symmetry group and its action are smuggled physics (free parameter); SBT neither enumerates conserved quantities nor predicts which symmetry is realized, so any 'prediction' is downstream of the declaration.

The stronger selection result requires a canonical-lens / orbit-selection principle that SBT explicitly lacks (pointer-basis/lens selection is a disclaimed missing interface), so it is research-grade, not a write-up.
Only EXACT orbit-constancy is handled; approximate/asymptotic/broken-symmetry conservation has no machinery.
proof_route.fallback_result: If even the unifying write-up is contested, the irreducible fallback is the bare Lean-certified statement F27 (StatusRecordsCoherence.ConservationAsOrbitDescent.conservation_as_orbit_descent, 'faithful'): for a declared orbit quotient, a readout is conserved iff it factors through that quotient. This is true, certified, and elementary, and stands regardless of any physics bridge.

card.baseline_comparison: Strictly weaker than the standard account on physics content, and at best a re-organization, not a derivation. SBT RECOVERS only the easy direction of Noether's framework (conserved <=> invariant on the symmetry orbit), which is a near-tautology equivalent to the standard 'a function on the quotient is a function constant on fibers'. It does NOT recover the deep direction (continuous symmetry of an action => existence of a conserved current), does not produce the Noether current J^mu, does not enumerate or predict conserved quantities, and imports the symmetry group as a declared input. The genuine added value over the textbook account is organizational: it places Noether/momentum, Lavoisier/mass, knot invariants, subject reduction, and martingales under one Lean-certified descent normal form, and connects 'conserved' to the SAME definability/closure machinery that certifies macro-observable admissibility (F18 Lawhood Descent, P5 packaging). So: recovers (trivially) + reorganizes (genuinely), does not exceed.
card.why_scientists_care: It is one of SBT's cleanest, most honest, Lean-anchored demonstrations of its core thesis that heterogeneous structural facts (conservation in physics, chemistry, knot theory, type theory, probability) are instances of a single quotient-definability/descent move. For physicists the payoff is conceptual compression and a precise statement of WHERE the physics enters (the declared symmetry and the symmetry->current map), cleanly separating the trivial descent bookkeeping from the substantive variational content of Noether. The fertile open question it sharpens is whether the SELECTION of the realized symmetry/conserved sector can be tied to an SBT stability/closure criterion, which would turn a re-description into a partial law.
target_audience: mathematical physicists working on symmetry and conservation laws
applied mathematicians and cross-domain modelers interested in unifying normal forms (knot invariants, type soundness, martingales)
card.recommended_artifact: A short focused note (4-6 pages): (1) state F27 as the conserved = orbit-quotient-definable = closure-invariant normal form, with the existing Lean theorem cited verbatim and its 'faithful' status explained (Lean covers only the stated biconditional, no physics); (2) derive it as a one-paragraph specialization of the Foundations I definability backbone (constant-on-fibers <=> factors-through-quotient, lines 1001-1005) and the HL-META-1 dynamics-descent reading; (3) tabulate the five layer instantiations plus Noether/momentum NAMED as the variational instance; (4) a prominent scope fence separating the certified easy direction from the un-derived current/selection content. Optionally ship the Lean snippet as a reproducibility artifact.
card.execution_cost: Low for the minimum-viable result: it is essentially a careful, honestly-fenced write-up of an already-proved, already-Lean-certified theorem plus its existing instantiations (days to weeks, no new mathematics). High/research-grade for the stronger selection result, which requires a canonical-lens / orbit-selection principle that SBT explicitly disclaims (open problem).
card.honest_status_note: GROUNDED and Lean-anchored, but must NOT be presented as 'deriving Noether'. The certified content (thm:F27, conservation_as_orbit_descent, semantic alignment 'faithful') is the elementary biconditional conserved<=>constant-on-orbits<=>factors-through-quotient, a 4-line universal-algebra argument; the paper itself states it 'does not enumerate conserved quantities' and Foundations IV 'is not a unification claim' (N3). Honest framing: a trivially-true, Lean-certified, genuinely-unifying RE-ORGANIZATION of conservation as descent, with Noether named as an instance, not produced.

adhoc_test_answers.question: Was the target fact (Noether/conservation laws) known before the theory component was built?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: Yes. Noether 1918, Lavoisier 1789, Reidemeister 1927, Meselson-Stahl 1958, Wright-Felleisen 1994, Doob 1953 all predate SBT. F27 is explicitly written to NAME these as instances ('The classical variational-symmetry instance of this orbit-descent reading is Noether's theorem'). The target was used to design the instantiation list, not predicted.

adhoc_test_answers.question: Is the matching mechanism a genuine derivation or a re-description / definitional identity?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: A definitional identity (re-description). 'Conserved' is DEFINED as orbit-constancy, so the biconditional 'conserved iff factors through q_orb' is the textbook universal-algebra fact 'a function on the quotient = a function constant on fibers' (Foundations I def lines 1001-1006). The F27 proof is 4 lines. SBT recovers only the trivial direction; it does NOT derive the existence-of-current (deep) direction of Noether.

adhoc_test_answers.question: How many free parameters/choices are absorbed relative to data matched?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: Roughly 6 adjustable structural choices (group/orbit, carrier, readout, lens depth, exact-vs-approx, dynamics-reading) against ZERO empirical data points (it is a structural normal form; SBT disclaims empirical realization). The ratio is unbounded: arbitrary freedom, no numeric target. Match is qualitative cross-domain consistency only.

adhoc_test_answers.question: Does the mechanism import known physics rather than produce it?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: Yes, almost entirely. The symmetry group and its action are 'smuggled physics' (declared inputs); ledger lists 'No continuum/Lagrangian/variational interface'. The actual content of Noether (symmetry of an action => conserved current) is OUT OF SCOPE (the card's own 'hard, not in papers' bridge lemma). SBT supplies only the descent bookkeeping atop imported group theory.

adhoc_test_answers.question: Would the theory have equally accommodated the OPPOSITE observation?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: Yes. If a quantity were observed NOT conserved, SBT accommodates this just as easily by declaring an orbit structure under which C fails to descend (the card's own 'null check': a gauge-variant coordinate 'fails to descend, so F27 correctly classifies it as non-conserved'). The free orbit declaration absorbs both outcomes symmetrically. F27 cannot be falsified by any conservation/non-conservation observation.

adhoc_test_answers.question: Does the same mechanism reuse across >=2 independent facts?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: Yes, strongly: the single orbit-descent mechanism is exhibited across 5 declared layers (Lavoisier mass, Reidemeister/Jones-Alexander knot invariants, subject reduction, Meselson-Stahl template-strand, martingale conditional expectation) plus Noether/momentum named as the variational instance. This cross-domain reuse is the genuine (organizational) value; mechanism_tag = orbit-descent.

adhoc_test_answers.question: Is the Lean certification load-bearing for the physics claim?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: No. The Lean theorem (conservation_as_orbit_descent, 'faithful') certifies only the elementary biconditional conserved<=>constant-on-orbits<=>factors-through-quotient. It does NOT certify any physics, any current, or which symmetry is realized. 'Faithful' (per app:formalization line 9810: 'uses the base wording without qualification') means Lean covers the same trivial statement, not the Noether content. Certification is real but applies to a near-tautology.

adhoc_test_answers.question: Does the claim cross any SBT disclaimer?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: Only if overstated. As fenced (F27 'does not enumerate conserved quantities', Noether 'named not derived'), it honors the disclaimers (no continuum theories, no continuum/variational interface). Crossing into 'SBT predicts conserved quantities' or 'derives the Noether current J^mu' WOULD violate the no-continuum disclaimer and the missing-interface ledger; the card flags this explicitly as forbidden.

opposite_world_test.explanation: F27 is symmetric under the observation it is meant to explain, because the orbit structure is a FREE declared input and 'conserved' is DEFINED as orbit-constancy. In a world where a putative quantity is NOT conserved, SBT 're-explains' it by declaring an orbit/symmetry under which C does not descend, and F27 classifies it as non-conserved with identical machinery (the candidate's own 'null check' does exactly this with a gauge-variant coordinate). Likewise it could host a fake/extra conservation law by declaring a coarser orbit. Because the group action carries all empirical content and is never produced or constrained by SBT (no orbit-selection principle; pointer/lens selection disclaimed), no conservation or non-conservation observation could falsify F27. This is the signature of an analytic re-description, not a predictive law: the biconditional is true in every possible world for any declared orbit. The genuine, non-vacuous content is purely organizational (one descent normal form across >=5 domains), and that organizational claim is itself unfalsifiable by physics.
